content:
rachael: quick sync - we're doing an EU->NA residency handoff for a small tenant cohort tomorrow. want a minimal playbook and explicit abort gates.

matt: agree. high risk is cascade fallbacks during lease-swap. propose flow: consent-filter -> kv-snapshot -> kms preflight -> prewarm -> canary -> lease-swap -> promote -> post-validate.

jyoti: add consent_stamp freshness (age <24h). exclude GDPR-no-copy tenants from the batch. checksum validation after promote is mandatory.

sam: short ops checklist to include:
- natalie validates consent.csv
- kv snapshot uploaded to s3://residency-archives/$CUTOVER_ID
- KMS/HSM keys present in NA
- standby pools prewarmed with weights + KV
- canary 1% for 10m; abort if p95>220ms or errors>0.5%

natalie: i'll deliver consent.csv by 11:00Z. format: tenant_id,jurisdiction,consent:true/false. will mark exclusions.

rachael: runbook snippet: 
```
./ops/consent_check --file tenants.csv || abort
./ops/kv_capture --tenants tenants.csv --dest s3://residency-archives/$CUTOVER_ID
./ops/kms_preflight --region na --keyfile tenants.csv || abort
POST /v1/pools/standby?action=prewarm&cutover=$CUTOVER_ID
route-control --set percent=1 --region na --cutover $CUTOVER_ID --duration 10m
./ops/leases_swap --tenants tenants.csv --mode auto --timeout 180s
POST /v1/pools/promote?cutover=$CUTOVER_ID
./ops/post_validate --sample 100 --checksum-threshold 1% || rollback
```
(matt: script 1/2/3 please)

matt: clarify auto: controller-coordinated preferred, fallback to ballot-based leaderless if controller unreachable >30s. ballot format: <cutover_id>-<region_priority>-<proxy_id>. allow swap only with 3/5 proxy quorum and checksum match. persist ballot to proxy local storage.

jyoti: add pre-swap invariants: inflight_per_tenant <300, outstanding_kv_writes <100, p95 <200ms. if violated, hold. also require consent_stamp_age <24h.

sam: telemetry: add cutover_id and ballot tags to metrics/traces; include X-Cutover-ID in request logs. create a Grafana row pre-filtered by cutover_id.

rachael: rollback commands to include: 
```
route-control --set percent=0 --region na --cutover $CUTOVER_ID
POST /v1/leases/revert?tenants=@tenants.csv
POST /v1/pools/standby?action=drain&cutover=$CUTOVER_ID
ops notify --page "cutover aborted $CUTOVER_ID"
```

jyoti: post-validate probes: sample 200 keys, checksum mismatch >1% => revert. semantic check: 50 prompt->embedding comparisons, cosine drift >0.12 => revert + page SRE.

matt: include --dry-run on all ops scripts so we can exercise preflight without changing routing. dry-run should simulate leases and checks.

infra-bot: deploybot: Cutover plan created: cutover-4623456789 by rachael. Canary window scheduled 2026-04-10T14:00Z.

rachael: action items:
- rachael: draft runbook + add --dry-run to scripts
- matt: implement ballot persistence lib and tests
- jyoti: implement checksum + embedding probes
- natalie: consent.csv and exclusion list
- sam: dashboard + telemetry tags

rachael: i'll push draft to docs/runbooks/residency-cutovers and request reviews. ping here for quick approvals. :white_check_mark:
